headline: Sales accelerate, margins expand across both segments
summary_short: Ralliant's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 12.8% y/y to $567.8M on 12.6% organic growth, with consolidated operating margin expanding 280bp to 14.5% as both segments improved profitability; diluted EPS grew 21.4% to $0.51 and the company fully settled a $101M accelerated share repurchase.
summary_long: Q2 revenue grew 12.8% y/y (12.6% organic) to $567.8M, led by 17.3% growth in Western Europe and 13.0% in North America. Gross profit rose 18.0% to $292.9M on volume and pricing gains. Sensors and Safety Systems' operating margin expanded 290bp to 28.4% on higher volumes and lapping pre-spin corporate allocations; Test and Measurement swung to a 2.4% operating margin from a 7.4% loss a year ago on 15.6% organic growth. Consolidated operating margin rose 280bp to 14.5%, partly offset by higher standalone public-company and dis-synergy costs. Net income rose 20.2% to $57.2M; diluted EPS +21.4% to $0.51. The company fully settled a $101M ASR, declared a $0.05/share dividend, and held $270.9M cash against $1,148.5M long-term debt.

drivers.explanation: Company-disclosed: sales grew 12.8% y/y on 12.6% organic growth (9.7% volume, 2.9% price); both segments expanded operating margin as pre-spin corporate allocations lapped, partially offset by higher standalone public-company and dis-synergy costs.
Company-disclosed: organic revenue grew 12.6% on 9.7% volume growth and 2.9% favorable pricing plus a 0.2% FX tailwind, led by 17.3% growth in Western Europe and 13.0% in North America.
Company-disclosed: the year-over-year increase in gross profit was primarily due to volume and pricing increases.

Company-disclosed: operating margin rose 280bp to 14.5% on higher volumes, price increases, and lapping pre-spin corporate allocations plus productivity savings, partly offset by higher employee costs and contract dis-synergies.
Derived-arithmetic: EBITDA growth of 28.3% tracks the 39.6% operating-income increase, reflecting the same volume, pricing, and margin dynamics plus depreciation and amortization.
Derived-arithmetic: net income growth of 20.2% trailed the 39.6% operating-income gain mainly on $13.8M of net interest expense this quarter versus none in the pre-spin prior-year period.
Derived-arithmetic: EPS growth of 21.4% slightly outpaced net income growth of 20.2% as weighted diluted shares fell modestly on share buybacks.
Company-disclosed: the year-over-year decrease was primarily attributable to the mix of earnings between jurisdictions, uncertain tax positions, and valuation allowances.

Not explained in the release for the modest q/q uptick; separately, the filing attributes the $318.8M-to-$270.9M year-to-date cash decline mainly to $151.5M of share repurchases and dividend payments.
Company-disclosed: debt was essentially unchanged sequentially; the Company borrowed and repaid $60 million under the Revolving Credit during the quarter with no net change to term debt.

Derived-arithmetic: equity fell q/q as $101M of ASR settlement and dividend payments outweighed the quarter's net income; the y/y comparison is not meaningful since pre-spin equity reflected a Net Former Parent investment balance instead of post-separation capital structure.
Company-disclosed: share count fell as the Company repurchased 2.8 million shares year-to-date, including the Q2 ASR settlement, under its expanded $500M buyback authorization.
